units: <cite ref="Eruvin 56a">Erub. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>הני מולייתא אַזְקְנוּן …</he> those ascents … made us (me) old, v. <cite ref="B00702"><he>בֵּירַאי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Niddah 47a">Nidd. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>אַזְקְנָא לה</he> (some ed. <he>אזקונא</he>, Asheri <he>אזקנה</he>) this would be a sign that she has entered old age (passed the change of life).
